g.title: FlareRank4Convo2 begins.
g.text: FlareRank4Convo2 begins.

g.title: j3471234379
g.text: I've been thinking about your problem, and I think I have an idea on how to get rid of Lizzie permanently.

g.title: j3254579099
g.text: All right. Let's work on negotiating some kind of peace, here...

g.title: j1639170042
g.text: Flare, are you there?

g.title: j3822122148
g.text: I need to talk to Lizzie.

g.title: j428905993
g.text: I need to talk to Lizzie.

g.title: j1528023593
g.text: We need to talk.

g.title: j2900999087
g.text: I don't think Lettie would appreciate if I had to sacrifice an animal...

g.title: j3899049749
g.text: Do I need to... draw a chalk circle on the ground or something?

g.title: j3830102397
g.text: I don't think Lettie would appreciate if I had to sacrifice an animal...

g.title: j2035882540
g.text: Do I need to... draw a chalk circle on the ground or something?

g.title: j2101215843
g.text: yeah?

g.title: j288564250
g.text: when This Demon calls.... We will always answer....

g.title: j1313107474
g.text: when This Demon calls.... We will always answer....

g.title: j3368154647
g.text: Check boolean FlareWar4

g.title: j3480775922
g.text: but You speak to Us of ridding the world of Us

g.title: j124818651
g.text: what do You need from Us, Sweet One?

g.title: j599239285
g.text: I think we take her to the Void. Make the Indifference deal with her.

g.title: j3368154647->j599239285
g.text: true

g.title: j3118946474
g.text: I think we find a way to kill Lizzie. I've killed thousands of Infested before. One more can't be hard.

g.title: j3368154647->j3118946474
g.text: true

g.title: j4212344564
g.text: Check boolean FlareWar4b

g.title: j3368154647->j4212344564
g.text: false

g.title: j2766683981
g.text: WHY

g.title: j3013340660
g.text: Flare is worried that once they let you in, you're going to consume their consciousness. They'll cease to be "them."

g.title: j1721340422
g.text: Can you describe to me how you're going to change them, exactly, if you get what you want? In... normal, non-cosmic horror terms, I mean.

g.title: j479985082
g.text: ...What could possibly go wrong...

g.title: j4084884995
g.text: I know you scoffed at the idea before, but I have *very* unique ways of killing things.

g.title: j4212344564->j599239285
g.text: true

g.title: j4212344564->j599239285
g.text: false

g.title: j4212344564->j3118946474
g.text: false

g.title: j2586022659
g.text: I've thought about your idea of trapping her in Duviri and... I think you're right. I think it'll work.

g.title: j4212344564->j2586022659
g.text: true

g.title: j4212344564->j2586022659
g.text: false

g.title: j2420574264
g.text: WHY should we heed YOUR words when YOU seek to drive US away?!

g.title: j1187865797
g.text: what is so special about being Them?

g.title: j1296048590
g.text: Boolean FlareNonCosmic is now true.

g.title: j3845688426
g.text: i'm willing to give anything a t

g.title: j3846913872
g.text: Shove her into the prison cells with Kullervo. She can keep him company.

g.title: j2359593911
g.text: Calm down! I was just trying to get Flare out of the way. I want to talk about negotiating some kind of peace between you two.

g.title: j1356203570
g.text: Because you're wrong, and they want you out of their life. So I'm going to find a way to kill you, throw you into the Void - or something. I don't care what.

g.title: j2473527087
g.text: They are an empty husk, a shell of a porcelain painted doll without Us

g.title: j192000906
g.text: We will do Our best... ;)

g.title: j3033480968
g.text: mmmmh.... dubious methods, but We are listening... go on

g.title: j3911598996
g.text: I am very, *very* good at killing the unkillable. Trust me.

g.title: j3900991567
g.text: We seek to fill Them up with Song. With Greatness. With that which They have sought Their entire lives

g.title: j2503139732
g.text: They chase the stars, and we consume Them

g.title: j2821843713
g.text: hhaaAHAHHAHHAHAHHAHA

g.title: j1012590988
g.text: and in joining with us, They will know what it is to be That which They Seek

g.title: j965017621
g.text: silly, foolish... little Demooon....

g.title: j3204984105
g.text: Check boolean FlareNonCosmic

g.title: j1037834219
g.text: did You thiiink... it would honestly be... So Simple...?

g.title: j3032852266
g.text: I'm starting to see why Flare thinks you're going to eat them, Lizzie.

g.title: j3204984105->j3032852266
g.text: true

g.title: j3204984105->j3032852266
g.text: false

g.title: j1184728854
g.text: Is that your best take on "non-cosmic horror" terms?

g.title: j3204984105->j1184728854
g.text: true

g.title: j2388967975
g.text: So... you *do* plan to consume their consciousness?

g.title: j3204984105->j2388967975
g.text: false

g.title: j2793610916
g.text: mmmhmmmmmmhehehehe....

g.title: j1116374386
g.text: ....sorry

g.title: j3349469340
g.text: y...es?

g.title: j717238214
g.text: We are going to let You into a... little secret...

g.title: j3638597230
g.text: We. Plan. To. Share? Their? Mind?

g.title: j4049737562
g.text: We will try again. Ahem.

g.title: j1519762315
g.text: We are not... the first Lizzie...

g.title: j3778370815
g.text: Is that. Better?

g.title: j1673690408
g.text: the first is at the bottom of the river...

g.title: j213238843
g.text: We are not very good at being Small

g.title: j851552153
g.text: the second, a charred and empty husk

g.title: j285390978
g.text: it is why We have not spoken to this Demon very often

g.title: j2252214273
g.text: the third, rejected, bones broken like a baby bird thrown from the nest like a neglectful mother

g.title: j954436399
g.text: I don't think "sharing" is going to be good enough for Flare.

g.title: j2877287213
g.text: When you say "share" though, do you mean... "share" like you tried to "share" Eleanor?

g.title: j2921507596
g.text: try... try... try...

g.title: j1415127912
g.text: but... isn't it fair...?

g.title: j2000100303
g.text: Yes! Precisely like that. She is such a Lovely One. We Love Her, So Very Much...

g.title: j2443838985
g.text: run... run... run...

g.title: j468396348
g.text: I don't think Flare will ever want to give up their personal identity, Lizzie. But I also don't see the value in trying to kill or destroy you.

g.title: j3550530480
g.text: You have to try to see things from Flare's perspective. They're afraid. They've lost everything. And now they're afraid they're going to lose the only thing they have left - themselves.

g.title: j3589948277
g.text: Why couldn't We have been Born to Her...

g.title: j1512012825
g.text: We... are ever-present... what would You be... without Us, TENNO...?

g.title: j827694526
g.text: but we are Their friend, not Their enemy...

g.title: j418719345
g.text: She would have Embraced Us...

g.title: j1293706449
g.text: kill us all You like for it is You who breeds us, Demon...

g.title: j2953809882
g.text: Then back off on the whole "consuming their consciousness" thing.

g.title: j2662292014
g.text: You've been doing a shit job at showing them that.

g.title: j2423886687
g.text: What's "sharing" to you, looks like "destruction" to us. You have to try to understand that. I know it's hard to "be small" but try. Remember what happened to Eleanor? And Lettie?

g.title: j4094745608
g.text: You have to try to see things from Flare's perspective. They're afraid. They've lost everything. And now they're afraid they're going to lose the only thing they have left - themselves.

g.title: j1285165599
g.text: oh... and before You go...?

g.title: j3819120730
g.text: We will... think...

g.title: j4022914150
g.text: We saw it a million times over, and then a half a million again in salvation...

g.title: j222620528
g.text: but We are Their friend, not Their enemy...

g.title: j4292067116
g.text: next time You slide inside of one of Us, one of our hollowed dolls...

g.title: j2211805572
g.text: Boolean FlarePeace5 is now true.

g.title: j1517983079
g.text: and again, and again, and again...

g.title: j2456618640
g.text: You've been doing a terrible job of showing them that.

g.title: j2327296329
g.text: next time We feel You delve into our depths, slipping into our Heat, our Warmth, our Embrace...

g.title: j2008359537
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3924247335
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1544370984
g.text: think to Yourself...

g.text: This Demon speaks sense...

g.text: is it just a little tighter than before...?

g.text: We will... consider Their words...
